newsitem.title: INDIA: India VSNL, BT project put on hold - report.
newsitem.headline: India VSNL, BT project put on hold - report.

text.p: India's Telecom Commission on Friday put on hold a decision on a proposed 16 billion rupee joint venture between state-run overseas telecommunications monopoly Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd (VSNL) and British Telecommunications Plc, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The news agency said the federal regulatory commission considered the proposal at a meeting but decided the issue should be "processed further".
Indian media have reported that VSNL and British Telecom plan a joint venture to make India a hub for international traffic.
All international traffic between Britain and the Middle East, South Asia and Southeast Asia would be grouped in India and then transmitted, newspapers have said.
VSNL and British Telecom would hold equal stakes in the venture, according to newspaper reports.
VSNL officials could not be reached for comment.
